newsitem.title: USA: U. Michigan consumer sentiment 103.2 May final.
newsitem.headline: U. Michigan consumer sentiment 103.2 May final.

text.p: The University of Michigan's final index of consumer sentiment for May rose to 103.2 compared to 101.4 in the final April index, financial market sources said on Friday.

The current conditions component fell to 113.5 in the final May report against the 115.2 reading in the final April. The expectations index rose to 96.6 in the May final data versus 92.5 in the final April.
The data are released only to paying subscribers.
